title_zh: 场景概念图生成档案（提示词全文、工具链、输出哈希）
title_en: Concept Scene Image Provenance (full prompts, tool chain, output hashes)
purpose_zh: 为六件场景概念图提供可独立核对的生成输入清单与交易过程登记：提示词全文、工具调用链、候选与选定、后处理链与最终输出哈希。配合 sources.json 中 OPENAI-TERMS-OF-USE-20260814 的条款存档快照，权利主张的每一环均可在包内或存档页面复核。
purpose_en: An independently checkable generation record for the six concept scene images: full prompts, tool chain, candidates and selection, post-processing chain and final output hashes. Together with the archived terms snapshot registered under OPENAI-TERMS-OF-USE-20260814 in sources.json, every link of the rights claim can be verified inside the package or on the archived page.

generation_chain.base_image_tool: OpenAI image generation, invoked through the Codex CLI native image generation tool by the GPT-5.6 Sol agent (codex exec, workspace-write sandbox)
generation_chain.annotation_layer: Hand-written HTML overlay (package design system: header band, bilingual title, coral badge 概念意象 · AI 生成 · 非工程依据, annotation cards, footer rights pointer), rendered with Chromium via Playwright at device scale factor 4
generation_chain.post_processing: PIL/Pillow: resize to 3000 px wide (LANCZOS), encode WebP quality 88 method 6
generation_chain.no_third_party_material: Prompts reference no third-party image, artwork or style name; the only image input to any generation call was the package's own site-overview.png figure (scene 3, as geographic layout reference).

scenes.name: scene-dual-state
scenes.title_zh: 双态并置：遗址公园通用可达底线，AI 开启 = AI 关闭
scenes.prompt_full: Photorealistic eye-level architectural visualization … generate ONE image split vertically down the exact center into two equal panels by a thin clean seam, showing THE SAME PLACE from THE SAME VIEWPOINT at the same dusk moment — a linear public greenway promenade in a historic Beijing railway heritage park (red-brick industrial rail buildings, preserved tracks to one side, mature trees, distant skyline). LEFT PANEL — smart systems ON: a soft teal light-guidance strip embedded flush in the paving glows gently and leads forward; slim ambient information totems softly lit; the scene feels calmly assisted. RIGHT PANEL — the exact same space with ALL smart systems OFF: no glow, totem screens dark; the space still works through permanent physical design — a low stone wayfinding wall with engraved lettering and a brass braille strip (abstract, non-legible, out of focus), a high-contrast tactile paving band, large fixed directional signage (abstract non-legible), a small staffed help point with warm conventional lighting. SAME people appear in both panels completing the same journey: an elderly man with a white cane walking ON the tactile paving band, a woman in a wheelchair on the SMOOTH paved lane (never on tactile paving), a child on a bicycle. Conventional street lighting is present in both panels (lighting is not a smart system). Hard constraints: no readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermarks, no UI overlays, no people looking at camera. Dusk warm-cool contrast, cinematic but restrained, true-to-life materials.

scenes.name: scene-interface-yard
scenes.title_zh: 众智园通用接口实验院：接口在公开测试中
scenes.prompt_full: Photorealistic eye-level architectural visualization, wide landscape: the inner courtyard of a 'universal interface testing yard' inside a Beijing tech-park campus (contemporary low-rise lab buildings with brick-and-glass facades around a calm courtyard). The courtyard is a public testing ground where city service interfaces are tested in the open: a ring of small freestanding interface stations at human scale (ticket-gate, kiosk, door, wayfinding post prototypes), each approachable from a continuous smooth accessible route; one clearly visible staffed HUMAN TAKEOVER point: a small warm-lit counter with a person present, positioned within the same line of sight as the stations; a continuous high-contrast equivalent-route band painted on the ground linking every station to the human counter — one calm teal-grey band, clearly a designed system, within one line of sight; a handful of diverse testers interacting: an older woman at a kiosk, a blind man with a white cane at a tactile model, a wheelchair user at a lowered counter, an engineer observing with a clipboard; status flags or small banners near stations kept ABSTRACT — plain colour markers (teal / amber / coral), no readable text. Late afternoon light, honest working atmosphere (a place being tested, not a showroom), true-to-life materials. Hard constraints: no readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermarks, no screens with legible UI.

scenes.name: scene-corridor-aerial
scenes.title_zh: 走廊鸟瞰：一条底线穿过真实的北京，地标各在其位
scenes.prompt_full:
The attached image is the official site-structure map of our proposal (a north-south heritage railway corridor park in Haidian, Beijing, from the Wudaokou area in the north down to Xizhimen in the south). Use it ONLY as a geographic layout reference for the corridor's shape, its three key areas and its two flanking wings.

Use your native image generation tool. Generate 2 candidate images, saved as scene3-geo-a.png and scene3-geo-b.png in the current working directory.

Image spec — photorealistic aerial architectural visualization of REAL Beijing at dusk, wide landscape, highest quality. Camera hovers about 500 m above the Wudaokou section of the Jingzhang railway heritage corridor, looking SOUTH along the corridor axis. Geographic program (bearings verified against real coordinates — follow strictly):

- FOREGROUND (bottom of frame): the preserved century-old Tsinghua-yuan railway station building (small grey-brick historic station with pitched roof) beside a green linear heritage park with preserved tracks and a generous accessible promenade with warm path lighting and small repeated node canopies.
- MID-GROUND CENTER-RIGHT at 2.8 km: the Dazhongsi area — a courtyard compound with a distinctive traditional Chinese bell-tower hall (Big Bell Temple) with sweeping tiled roofs, gently lit, next to a market-hall district.
- NEAR RIGHT at about 2 km: the Zhongguancun tech cluster — contemporary mid-rise and high-rise office towers with lit facades.
- NEAR LEFT: the small Xiaoyue River waterway running parallel to the corridor through everyday residential fabric, with a lit riverside path.
- FAR END OF CORRIDOR, CENTER at 5.5 km: Beijing North railway station with its arched roof and a fan of tracks, beside the three curved Xizhimen towers.
- DISTANT LEFT HORIZON at about 14 km: the Beijing CBD skyline cluster — CITIC Tower (China Zun, the tallest, its distinctive tapered vase silhouette) with the stepped China World Trade Center Tower III and surrounding cluster, hazy in dusk light.
- DISTANT RIGHT at about 9.5 km: the Central Radio and TV Tower — slender needle with a spherical observation pod, silhouetted.
- EXTREME RIGHT HORIZON: the soft dark ridge of the Western Hills (Xishan).
- The rest of the fabric: authentic Haidian mid-rise academic and residential blocks (Beijing's real grain: slab housing, tree-lined ring roads, an elevated ring road crossing the corridor mid-distance).

The corridor itself reads as ONE continuous calm lit ribbon (warm consistent lighting, ten small evenly spaced node canopies as subtle pools of light). No invented mega-landmarks, no fictional towers. Blue-hour sky, restrained realistic city lighting, true Beijing atmosphere.

Hard constraints: no readable text, no logos, no watermarks. After generating both, print SCENE3GEO-DONE.
scenes.geo_program_note_zh: 提示词中的地标方位与距离由真实 WGS84 坐标推算（视点五道口段 39.992N 116.337E，镜头朝向约 167°）；图注与标注层同口径声明为概念意象、非测绘复原。

speech_synthesis_cross_reference.note_zh: 合成语音的输入清单与交易参数此前已随包登记，此处汇总指针以便一处核对：输入台本为 assets/media/audio-guide.md §三（26 句逐句台本，与 VTT 逐字同源）与 journey.md §二（11 句分镜台本）；模型、音色、调用工具与拼接参数登记于 audio-guide.md §四 与 journey.md §五；条款存档快照见 sources.json MINIMAX-PLATFORM-TOS-20260814 的 archive_url。

limitations_zh: 生成服务本身不提供逐次调用的第三方签名回执；本档案登记的是方案方可提供的全部输入与输出证据（提示词、工具链、哈希、条款快照），不构成平台出具的交易凭证。
